# Maia Construction — Massachusetts Home Improvement Contractor

> Maia Construction is a licensed and insured home improvement contractor (MA HIC #204634) based in Marlborough, Massachusetts. Founded in 2015 by Marcos, the company specializes in siding installation, window replacement, door installation, and general contracting services across 100+ Massachusetts cities.

## Core Services

### 1. Siding Installation
Maia Construction offers professional siding installation including vinyl siding, James Hardie fiber cement siding, wood siding, and engineered wood siding. Services include complete tear-off and replacement, insulated siding options, trim and fascia work, and housewrap installation. Certified installer for CertainTeed, Alside, and James Hardie products. Benefits include up to 20% energy savings, lifetime fade protection, and 25-50 year manufacturer warranties.

### 2. Window Replacement
Professional window replacement services featuring ENERGY STAR certified double-pane and triple-pane windows. Available types include double-hung, casement, bay, bow, and picture windows in vinyl, fiberglass, and wood frames. All windows include Low-E glass coating and argon/krypton gas fill. Homeowners typically see 30% reduction in heating/cooling costs, 50% noise reduction, and 99% UV blocking.

### 3. Door Installation
Complete door installation services including entry doors (fiberglass, steel, wood), patio doors (sliding, French, bi-fold), and storm doors. Brands include Therma-Tru, ProVia, and Andersen. Features include smart lock installation, decorative glass inserts, and multi-point locking systems. Entry door replacement offers 90%+ ROI at resale.

### 4. General Contractor Services
Full-scope home improvement including exterior renovations, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, home additions, deck and patio construction, and basement finishing. Maia Construction handles all permit acquisition and inspections. Every project includes a 5-year workmanship warranty.

## Service Area

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does siding installation cost in Massachusetts?**
A: Vinyl siding typically costs $6-12 per square foot installed, while James Hardie fiber cement siding costs $9-15 per square foot installed. Costs vary based on home size, material choice, and complexity. Maia Construction provides free detailed written estimates.

**Q: How long does a siding installation take?**
A: Most residential siding projects take 3-7 days. A standard 2,000 sq ft home typically takes 4-5 days.

**Q: How much can I save on energy bills with new windows?**
A: ENERGY STAR certified replacement windows can reduce heating and cooling costs by 12-33%. Massachusetts homeowners typically save $100-400 per year.

**Q: What is the difference between double-pane and triple-pane windows?**
A: Double-pane windows have two glass layers with insulating gas. Triple-pane adds a third layer for 20-30% better insulation, ideal for New England winters, at 10-15% higher cost.

**Q: Does Maia Construction handle building permits?**
A: Yes, Maia Construction handles all necessary permits and inspections as part of the service, ensuring projects meet all local building codes.

**Q: What warranties does Maia Construction offer?**
A: All installations include manufacturer warranties (25-50 years on materials) plus a 5-year workmanship warranty from Maia Construction.

**Q: Does Maia Construction offer financing?**
A: Yes, flexible financing options are available including 0% interest financing for qualified buyers.
